title: Named, enforced authority gate separating local authoring from shared-ontology promotion

defect_addressed.evidence: VisionFlow/docs/estate-review/agent-grounding-and-governance.md + evidence/agent-snapshot.json — AGENTBOX_ONTOLOGY_LOCAL=1 made the bridge dispatch locally BEFORE the remote axiom descriptor, so a probe edited a temporary Markdown corpus with no Whelk validation and no human gate while direct_axiom_load = false was still in force. A policy table only constrains callers that invoke a gate; nothing invoked one.
defect_addressed.fix: assertAuthoringAuthority() in mcp/servers/lib/ontology-authoring-authority.js is the single, named gate. createAuthoredCorpusWriter() is the only sanctioned route from any caller to the Markdown-writing helper (ontology-local.js axiomAdd/propose), and both of its entry points call the gate first. ontology-bridge.js routes both write tools through it; the FORCE_LOCAL dispatch still runs first, but it no longer confers authority.
defect_addressed.status: closed for the bridge; one CLI caller remains outside the gate (see remaining_bypasses)

forced-local.note: FORCE_LOCAL selects a backend for READS; authoring needs an explicit opt-in beyond it plus a manifest key.

remote-disabled.note: An outage withdraws the governed write path; it does not grant a local one.

bootstrap.note: Zero-tolerance. The authorisation reference is RECORDED here, not verified here — signature verification remains the management-api authority consumer's responsibility.

governed-proposal.note: Writes no local file. A direct-axiom-load request in this mode is converted into a proposal rather than executed.

enforcement.deny_by_default: An unrecognised or absent mode is denied (ontology_authoring_unknown_mode). An absent manifest key is false, never 'unset therefore allowed'.
enforcement.typed_denial: OntologyAuthorityError carries code, mode, target, operation and missing_authority[] naming the exact authorities absent. toResult() gives the MCP wire shape with authorised:false, written:false — never a silent no-op and never a silent write.
enforcement.direct_axiom_load: operation direct-axiom-load is blocked in forced-local, remote-disabled and bootstrap whenever manifest skills.ontology.direct_axiom_load !== true; governed-proposal is the sole exception and converts it into a proposal. The local-authoring opt-in does NOT unlock the axiom backdoor.
enforcement.shared_store: Any mode other than governed-proposal targeting shared-ontology is denied with ontology_shared_store_forbidden_in_local_mode.

recorded_in: the grant returned to the caller (correlation_id, chain_stages, stage)
the authored artefact's V2 frontmatter (ontology-authoring-correlation / -mode / -stage) via lib/vault-frontmatter ensureFrontmatter, so the page stays in vault format
correlation_chain.reuse: An id minted at an earlier chain stage can be passed in and is carried through unchanged.

manifest_state_verified.consequence: With the manifest as shipped, local authoring is denied in every mode and the axiom backdoor is blocked everywhere except the governed conversion. Enabling local authoring requires adding local_authoring = true under [skills.ontology] — an intentional, reviewable manifest edit outside this change's scope.

write tools routed through handleLocalWrite → the gated writer; handleLocal now takes the authoring mode; no direct L.axiomAdd / L.propose call remains

agentbox.toml (adding skills.ontology.local_authoring is a governed manifest edit, out of scope)

limitations: Hermetic helper-level enforcement with a temp corpus and injected env/manifest. It establishes that every bridge caller passes the gate and that a denial writes nothing; it is not a full MCP transport test.
The bootstrap authorisation reference is recorded, not cryptographically verified, in this module. No cryptography is implemented here.

The remote ontology_axiom_add path retains its existing ontology-propose.js guard (AGENTBOX_ONTOLOGY_DIRECT_LOAD, default off) and was NOT re-routed through this gate, to avoid altering the admin/bootstrap remote-load contract in the same change.

The correlation id links the authoring act to the artefact. Carrying the same id through an actual Whelk validation, PR, approval and merge requires the VisionClaw-side stages to accept and echo it — not established here.
